# Fitness tracker: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Heart-rate data must not be sold to advertisers, under the Health Data Pledge. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a wearer, I want to set a weekly step goal so that I stay motivated.
US-2 As a wearer, I want to compare runs so that I see progress.
US-3 As a wearer, I want my pulse readings never passed to ad companies for money so that nobody profits from my health.
constraints: Heart-rate data must not be sold to advertisers, under the Health Data Pledge.
